rubrics.justification: Describes a good-quality expanded blastocyst with compact ICM, cohesive TE, and thinned zona, which is consistent with the provided 3AA grading; minor uncertainty remains because the image-based staging is somewhat hedged and not highly specific.
Thoroughly integrates age, prior live birth, ovarian reserve, endometrial thickness, BMI, semen parameters, and endometriosis with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates tied to embryo quality and patient factors; only minor overreach in discussing miscarriage/endometriosis effects without case-specific severity details.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice: reliance on Gardner grading, support for single embryo transfer, acknowledgment of morphology limits, and standard transfer counseling; slight deductions for a few speculative points not tightly guideline-based.
Provides practical next steps for transfer, SET, luteal support, and lifestyle counseling, plus future planning considerations; useful but future-cycle planning is somewhat incomplete/truncated.
